[RAOT.5.1] The `arch` field is a short, well-known string.
The following values are normative:

| String            | Architecture                             |
|-------------------|------------------------------------------|
| `amd64`           | x86-64 (AMD64 / Intel 64)               |
| `arm64`           | AArch64 (ARMv8-A 64-bit)               |
| `rv64g`           | RISC-V 64-bit, base + G extensions      |
| `rv64gc`          | RISC-V 64-bit, G + C extensions         |
| `xtensa-esp32s3`  | Xtensa LX7 32-bit (ESP32-S3)            |
